Hi Alex — thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, I’m attaching version 2 of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with the load/perf test milestone fleshed out. Quick recap of the open items we covered that affect scheduling and capacity sizing:

- Target peak QPS: you indicated ~1,200 QPS at peak (checkout flow).
- Traffic replay: you’ll send a sanitized replay bundle capturing representative traffic for the peak window.
- Success criteria: 99.9% p50 latency < 250ms and no more than 2% error rate under load.
- Dependency: access to a staging S3 bucket with replay files and JFrog endpoint for client logs.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm the exact 1-hour window we should replay (we suggest Tue 2026-08-25 10:00–11:00 PT).
2) You upload the replay bundle and share a link to the staging bucket.
3) Our infra team (cc’d: Rishi and Aditya) will size a dedicated pool and confirm GPU count and expected throughput.
4) Run a smoke test 48 hours before and the full traffic replay on the scheduled date.

Can you confirm the replay date and whether the bundle will include session affinity headers? Also attaching the MAP-draft-v2.pdf for your review.

Thanks,

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-08-19T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Load/perf test scheduling & capacity sizing

Adding some quick sizing notes based on the stated 1,200 QPS and mixed token lengths for checkout prompts:

- Baseline estimate (unquantized): ~3.5k tokens/sec sustained on an rtx-a6000-class instance per two GPUs for our optimized runtime. To sustain 1,200 QPS with average 20 tokens/request we’re looking at ~24k tokens/sec peak, which suggests a 8-GPU dedicated pool as a conservative starting point.
- With GPT-style models and 4-bit quantization we can probably drop to 5–6 GPUs for the same SLOs.
- We’ll run a calibrated smoke test at 25% load first, then ramp to 100% during the full replay.

Ask for Marissa/Alex: once we have the replay bundle, Aditya can run a quick local replay and return concrete GPU/hour estimate and a recommended test run schedule. I can also produce a simple cost estimate to add to the MAP milestones (monthly reserved vs. burst).

Rishi
Director, Inference Ops | Redwood Inference
